permission.description: One entry of the permission catalog (spec/00-conventions.md §5); membership in the catalog is checked by the domain, not by the schema.

token_kind.description: personal: human/service token; worker: token of a worker process (TTL access.tokens.worker_ttl_hours, rotated); assignment: runtime/MCP token of one assignment step (scope = run; .read permissions also cover the ancestors of the run, writes only the run and below; never worker.claim; carries assignment_id and step_id; expires with the lease).
